doubts: This page describes two tramping tracks (1000 Acre Plateau; Upper Matiri Valley) in hut-to-hut legs rather than one walk, so it is recorded as a network. Both tracks are reached from the DOC carpark at Matiri roadend by the Lake Matiri Hut Track (1.5 hr to Lake Matiri Hut), which has no road-end feature in the packet; the ways are started at Lake Matiri Hut as the section headings do. The page does not say whether trampers return the same way or exit elsewhere, so 'one_way' reflects only that each is described from A to B. Per-leg times are given (3 hr + 3 hr; 9 hr + 10+ hr) but not a whole-way time. Poor Petes Hut, Larrikins Creek Hut and Wangapeka Saddle have no packet entry. W3 (Hurricane Hut to Wangapeka Saddle) is an unmarked ridge-top route described under the Upper Matiri Valley heading; it could instead be considered an extension of W2. Huts lists the huts on all the described ways (McConchies Hut and Hurricane Hut are on W2, not the main way). Exits down Larrikins Creek to the Mokihinui River (to Seddonville or Lyell) are mentioned only as options for experienced trampers.
